subject: general
question: In what time at 10% per annum simple interest a sum becomes 3 times of itself.
solution:
**Given:**

Rate = 10%

Amount = 3 × Principal

**Formula Used:**

S.I = PRT/100

A = P + S.I

Where, S.I = Simple Interest

P = Principal, R = Rate,

T = Time, A = Amount

**Calculation:**

According to the question 

A = 3P

P + S.I = 3P

⇒ S.I = 2P

⇒ (P × 10 × T)/100 = 2P

⇒ PT/10 = 2P

⇒ T/10 = 2

⇒ T = 20 years

**∴ The period of time is 20 years.**
